text:
Read-only investigation for run 2026-11-09-ui-v3 — pinpoint two v2 defects (no edits).

Context: G0 and the R0 update run on the capture host show desktop/e2e/screens.visual.spec.ts 'providers 390x844' (ar/en x light/dark) failing two soft assertions at 390px while 768/1440 pass:
(1) auditLayout (spec line 66, helpers under apps/desktop/e2e/support/): emptyBoxes — a <span> holding the text 'لم يُختبر بعد' / 'not tested yet' measures 0x63 (ar) / 0x54 (en);
(2) auditUsedFonts (spec line 74): the element [data-warsha-font-probe="mono"] holds the Arabic label 'العنوان الافتراضي لهذا النوع' at 390px and is drawn with DejaVu Sans Mono (IBM Plex Mono has no Arabic glyphs).
These are v0.2.1 v2 screen defects. The run forbids v2 edits until U7, so the owner is being asked to approve a minimal fix packet; your job is to cost it precisely. Repo: C:/Users/Dragonfly/Downloads/Warsha at dev ba90e71.

Questions:
1. Which v2 file:line renders the connection-status span ('لم يُختبر بعد' / 'not tested yet') on the providers screen, and which CSS rule collapses it to zero width at 390px (flex/min-width/overflow)? Give the offending declaration.
2. Which v2 file:line puts data-warsha-font-probe="mono" on a box whose text is the Arabic default-URL label at mobile width, and why do wider widths pass (what text does the probe hold there)?
3. Propose the minimal fix spelling for each (logical CSS only; correct font family/stack for Arabic text; no design change), list exactly which files would change, and grep whether any other v2 screen shares either pattern (status span, mono probe with Arabic).
4. Confirm the audit helpers' contract (what emptyBoxes and the mono probe actually check) so a fix targets the real assertion, not a workaround.

Non-goals: no file edits, no test or gate changes, no v3 work, no Playwright runs, no commits, no installs. Read/grep only.
Deliverable: final answer under 350 words — file:line findings, the two minimal fixes, shared-pattern list, uncertainties. Do not edit state.json, PROGRESS.md or DECISIONS.md.
